children: The chariman of Brazilian lender Bradesco

, Luiz Carlos Trabuco, is expected to meet Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Thursday, a person close to the matter told Reuters, amid reports the executive could take over the country's finance ministry.

Reuters reported earlier on Thursday, citing two people with knowledge of the negotiations, that Lula had already approached Trabuco over the finance minister role for his next term. Local newspaper Estadao first reported the meeting.
